title: Grateful Dead Live at Portland Memorial Coliseum on 1980-06-12
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi CR-7A) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6 MHz) >KORG AudioGate 4 > Adobe Audition CC2015 > Samplitude Pro X3 Suite > FLAC/24

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording with clear vocals; a solid second set highlighted by a funky Fire On The Mountain and a strong Estimated Prophet despite an unremarkable first set.
ai_review.review: The SBD capture is clean and balances the band well, letting Jerry’s voice come through clearly. While reviewers found the first set lackluster, the second set shines with a fiery Fire On The Mountain and a tightly‑run Estimated Prophet. Overall the performance is mixed but leans positive thanks to those standout moments.

ai_rating.rationale: One detailed review gives a balanced view (good board quality, strong second‑set songs, weaker first set) and a second generic positive note; combined weight yields a solid but not outstanding rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear mix with all instruments represented; Jerry's vocals are articulate and no major drop‑outs or muddiness reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set described as unremarkable; second set picks up energy with a funky Fire and a solid Estimated Prophet, making the overall show feel stronger in its latter half.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Voice clear and articulate; guitar playing described as fierce on Fire On The Mountain.
